svg.text: Aurora card files SHALL be stored as strict JSON (RFC 8259) using the .jsjson extension: double quotes, no comments, no trailing commas, UTF-8 encoding, and exactly one trailing newline.

Aurora cards SHALL use stable identifiers (e.g., MIS-001) that MUST NOT change once issued. Card files SHALL be named <id>-<Sanitized_Name>.jsjson, where special characters are stripped and spaces are replaced with underscores. Models SHALL follow the Model Home and Mission folder layout conventions so tools can discover, validate, and render deterministically.

Each Aurora model SHALL start with exactly one Mission card that serves as the root of the directed graph. The Mission card SHALL only have outgoing links and SHALL provide a consistent starting point for traversal and view generation.
All Aurora links SHALL lead away from the Mission card. Local cycles MAY exist within bounded subgraphs (for example state machines) as long as no link creates a path back to the Mission.

Boundary cards SHALL be used to group related cards for rendering and navigation; they may have a subtype such as End to limit recursion. Note cards SHALL be used only as annotative leaves (incoming links only) and SHALL NOT introduce new structural model elements.
Aurora tooling and documentation SHALL use a canonical registry of card types (and optional subtypes) to support consistent rendering, validation, and communication across tools.
Aurora tooling and documentation SHALL use a canonical registry of relationship verbs, including allowed source and target card types, to enable deterministic validation and interoperable views.
Aurora tooling and documentation SHALL use a canonical registry of view definitions that declare which card types are included and what root types anchor each view.
All Aurora card files SHALL include a $schema field referencing the applicable Aurora schema using a relative path from the card file to the Model Home schema file.

Aurora models SHALL be machine-validatable for integrity: every non-Mission, non-Note card SHALL have at least one incoming link; every card SHALL be reachable from the Mission; and all links[].target values SHALL reference an existing card id.

Views SHALL be treated as projections of a single underlying model graph by selecting a set of card types (and optional subtypes) and rendering only those cards and the links between them; views SHALL NOT change the underlying model.

All Aurora cards SHALL include an audit_trail with a per-card SemVer version, an optional SHA256 hash (nullable), and a chronological history of created/edited/deleted events including editor identity and RFC3339 timestamps.

Aurora card and relationship labels SHALL be treated as descriptive metadata; the meaning of the architecture SHALL be derived from the model’s invariant rules and the current view’s inclusion/projection of card types and links.
